channel.title: The Grant Desk - NL, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: NL, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Grant: Rijksmuseum Meermanno x Amarte: new work on Power and Powerlessness (The Hague; EUR 8,500 fee plus EUR 4,000 production budget) (closes 24 Nov)
item.description:
Amarte Fonds and Rijksmuseum Meermanno, House of the Book
Deadline: 24 Nov 2026, 23:59 CET
Award: EUR 8,500 artist's fee plus a EUR 4,000 production budget, with content support during the research and artistic guidance. The artwork remains the artist's property. No application fee mentioned.

Amarte and Rijksmuseum Meermanno, the museum of the book in The Hague, select one artist for a research and work period in the museum's collection, ending in an exhibition. The museum's 2027 programme theme is Power and Powerlessness, and applicants are encouraged to connect with it.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Grant: BPD Cultuurfonds: sponsorship for art in public space (up to EUR 70,000 per project; round closing 1 December 2026) (closes 1 Dec)
item.description:
Stichting BPD Cultuurfonds
Deadline: 1 Dec 2026, 12:00 CET
Award: Up to EUR 70,000 excluding VAT per project or project component, paid 80% at the start of execution and 20% after completion and the final report. The fund does not cover full costs: the funding plan must show a real shortfall and other contributions. Applicants' own fees are not covered. No application fee mentioned.

BPD Cultuurfonds sponsors publicly accessible art and culture projects in the Netherlands that improve the quality and experience of public or semi-public space. This is the route for large outdoor installations and artworks tied to a place.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Grant: Fonds Podiumkunsten: Productiesubsidie 2027, round 1 (up to EUR 78,750 per production, EUR 105,000 with 50% own income) (closes 6 Jan 2027)
item.description:
Fonds Podiumkunsten (Performing Arts Fund NL)
Deadline: 6 Jan 2027, 23:59 CET
Award: Up to EUR 78,750 per production; up to EUR 105,000 if the production covers at least 50% of its costs from own income; up to EUR 52,500 for a concours. Up to EUR 26,250 extra for a new composition, libretto or theatre text. At least 20% of production costs must come from own income. No application fee mentioned.

The Performing Arts Fund's main production grant, and the largest single-project subsidy for theatre and performance in the Netherlands. It funds new productions, reprises, coproductions and concours in the professional performing arts.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Grant: vfonds: Onze Democratie and Onze Vrijheid project grants (rolling under EUR 50,000; larger grants due 14 January 2027) (closes 14 Jan 2027)
item.description:
vfonds (Nationaal Fonds voor Vrede, Vrijheid en Veteranenzorg)
Deadline: 14 Jan 2027
Award: No published maximum. Requests under EUR 50,000 are rolling; requests of EUR 50,000 or more go to four fixed rounds a year. vfonds covers at most 50% of project costs. No application fee mentioned.

Two parallel schemes for public projects about democracy, the rule of law and freedom, and one of the few large Dutch funders where justice themes are the point of the call.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Grant: Gemeente Den Haag: Arts and Culture Projects 2027, spring windows (Category A up to EUR 10,000, Category B up to EUR 30,000) (closes 15 Feb 2027)
item.description:
Gemeente Den Haag (Haagse Kunst- en Cultuurprojecten)
Deadline: 15 Feb 2027, 23:59 CET
Award: Category A: EUR 2,000 to EUR 10,000, covering at most 70% of the budget (open to individuals). Category B: EUR 10,000 to EUR 30,000, covering at most 30% of the budget (legal entities only). No application fee mentioned.

The City of The Hague's project subsidy for public-facing work in theatre, music, dance, film, literature, visual arts or any combination. WHO: professional arts organisations, broedplaatsen and artists active in The Hague.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Grant: Fonds Podiumkunsten: Urban Arts Projects 2027 (rolling from 1 January; up to EUR 15,000 for individuals, EUR 25,000 for collectives)
item.description:
Fonds Podiumkunsten (Performing Arts Fund NL)
Deadline: Rolling, apply any time
Award: Up to EUR 15,000 for individuals and up to EUR 25,000 for companies and collectives, for time, materials and third-party services. No application fee mentioned.

A project grant for theatre, dance, music and spoken-word makers rooted in urban culture who are established in their own scene but have not yet broken through nationally. The 2026 budget is spent; applications reopen on 1 January 2027 and are then handled continuously while the budget lasts.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Open call: Erasmus University Rotterdam: Postdoc, Social and Ethical Aspects of Digital Twins (0.8 FTE) (closes 23 Nov)
item.description:
Erasmus University Rotterdam, Erasmus School of Philosophy
Deadline: 23 Nov 2026
Award: EUR 4,925 to EUR 6,682 gross a month on a full-time basis (scale 11), pro rata for 0.8 FTE

A 0.8 FTE postdoc at the Erasmus School of Philosophy studying the social and ethical aspects of digital twins in an ELSA social-lab setting.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Open call: Delft Fringe Festival 2027: open call for new performing-arts makers (expense allowance and coaching) (closes 30 Nov)
item.description:
Delft Fringe Festival
Deadline: 30 Nov 2026
Award: Every maker or company receives an expense allowance; the amount is not published. Artistic coaching and maker workshops included. No application fee mentioned.

A location-theatre festival for makers at the start of a professional career, staged in unusual venues across Delft. WHO: makers and companies in any performing-arts genre, formally trained or self-taught, with new or existing work in any language.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Open call: TU Eindhoven: Postdoc, Human-Centered AI, Accessibility and Sign Language Technology (0.8 FTE) (closes 30 Nov)
item.description:
Eindhoven University of Technology, Department of Industrial Design
Deadline: 30 Nov 2026
Award: EUR 4,422 to EUR 5,760 gross a month on a full-time basis (scale 10), pro rata for 0.8 FTE, plus 8% holiday allowance and 8.3% year-end bonus

A 0.8 FTE postdoc in the Industrial Design department at TU Eindhoven on the SignFlow project, which translates Dutch into Dutch Sign Language (NGT) through a 3D avatar. The work covers human-AI interaction, accessibility and validating user research with the deaf community.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Open call: Tilburg University: Postdoc, AI for Understanding Visual Narratives (0.8 to 0.9 FTE) (closes 1 Dec)
item.description:
Tilburg University, School of Humanities and Digital Sciences
Deadline: 1 Dec 2026
Award: EUR 3,546 to EUR 4,728 gross a month on a full-time basis (scale 10), pro rata for 32 to 36 hours a week

Postdoc in the Department of Intelligent Systems applying computer vision and vision-language models to Rich Pictures, drawings made by palliative-care patients to tell their stories, in collaboration with Amsterdam UMC.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Open call: TU Eindhoven: Postdoc, Human-AI Interaction and Risk-Minimizing Digital Design in Gambling (18 months) (closes 2 Dec)
item.description:
Eindhoven University of Technology, Department of Industrial Engineering and Innovation Sciences
Deadline: 2 Dec 2026
Award: EUR 4,422 to EUR 5,760 gross a month (scale 10, full-time), plus 8% holiday allowance and 8.3% year-end bonus

Full-time postdoc in the Human-Technology Interaction group on UI-PRIG, a two-year project with the Trimbos Institute on how online gambling platforms present risk information.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Open call: Noorderlicht Biennale PLAY! 2027: open call for lens-based, AI, generative and game-based work (artist fee, production covered) (closes 15 Dec)
item.description:
Noorderlicht
Deadline: 15 Dec 2026, 23:59 CET
Award: Selected artists receive an artist fee (amount not published). Noorderlicht pays for production: printing and framing, insurance and transport. Entry fee EUR 5 per project.

Noorderlicht, the Groningen house of photography and lens-based media, is selecting work for its 2027 biennale, PLAY!, curated by Marijn Bril and Grazyna Siedlecka. The biennale opens in September 2027 at locations across Groningen, Friesland and Drenthe and will show around 75 artists.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Open call: Tetem: Maker Festival Twente 2027 open call for makers (interactive art and media installations; paid, amount not published) (closes 15 Mar 2027)
item.description:
Tetem, with Makerfestival Twente, Cinekid in Overijssel and Twentse Maakplaatsen
Deadline: 15 Mar 2027
Award: A fee is available for independent makers; the amount is not published. Companies take part unpaid. No application fee mentioned.

Tetem, the Enschede platform for digital culture, is programming its four-day Maker Festival Twente for children aged 6 to 12 and their parents. WHO: independent makers, plus companies and knowledge partners.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Grant: Fonds BJP Press Play 2027: Development Programme for Journalistic Makers (closes 30 Nov)
item.description:
Fonds BJP (Fonds voor Bijzondere Journalistieke Projecten)
Deadline: 30 Nov 2026
Award: EUR 3,200 towards about 20 days of time invested, plus a personal coach and workshops. No application fee.

Press Play helps makers develop and pitch a journalistic or creative project, with five places in each of four tracks: audio, video, writing and photo.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Grant: Mondriaan Fund: Call for Proposals, Dutch Pavilion at the Venice Biennale Arte 2028 (EUR 500,000 presentation budget) (closes 1 Dec)
item.description:
Mondriaan Fund
Deadline: 1 Dec 2026, 16:00 CET
Award: EUR 500,000 (incl. VAT, excl. fees) presentation budget for the selected team; up to 4 shortlisted teams receive EUR 5,000 each to develop their plan.

The first open call for the Dutch entry to the Venice Biennale Arte since 2018, run by the Mondriaan Fund for the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Grant: AFK Amsterdam Fund for the Arts: Project Subsidies 2026-2028 (closes 2 Dec)
item.description:
Amsterdams Fonds voor de Kunst (AFK)
Deadline: 2 Dec 2026, 15:00 CET
Award: Category 1: EUR 1,500 to 2,500; category 2: EUR 2,500 to 7,500; category 3: EUR 7,500 to 17,500 (includes artistic development, replacing the old stipend); category 4: EUR 17,500 and up. No application fee.

The general Amsterdam project grant for individuals, collectives and organisations living or working in Amsterdam or nearby municipalities, across disciplines including digital and media work.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Grant: Awesome Foundation Local Chapters: USD 1,000 Monthly Micro-grants (US, UK, Canada, Australia, NL, Asia) (rolling)
item.description:
Awesome Foundation (local chapters)
Deadline: Rolling, apply any time
Award: Usually USD 1,000 (or local equivalent) per grant, no strings attached, typically one grant per chapter per month. No application fee.

The Awesome Foundation is a network of volunteer giving circles: in each chapter about ten trustees pool their own money to give a USD 1,000 no-strings micro-grant, usually monthly, to a project that adds "awesome" to their area: art, public interventions, community tech, events, science and civic...

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Residency: H401 WONDER open call: 4-week artist residency in Amsterdam on women in the European Resistance (EUR 3,000 fee plus production budget) (closes 6 Dec)
item.description:
H401 (Stichting Herengracht 401), within the EU-funded WONDER project led by ECCOM
Deadline: 6 Dec 2026, 23:59 CET
Award: Artist fee of EUR 3,000, production costs reimbursed up to EUR 1,000, plus travel, accommodation (if applicable) and subsistence under EU travel guidelines. Travel and accommodation for the final event in Rome are also covered. No application fee stated.

Women Narratives during the European Resistance (WONDER) is a 15-month EU project (CERV programme) in five countries; each partner hosts one artist, and this is the Dutch call, for 1 artist.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Residency: Flora *AiR 2027: 12-week funded studio residency for The Hague-based visual artists (EUR 1,500/month fee) (closes 13 Dec)
item.description:
Flora Filmtheater, funded by Café Restaurant Flora
Deadline: 13 Dec 2026, 23:59 CET
Award: Artist fee of EUR 1,500 per month plus a material/production budget of EUR 1,000. Collectives and duos share the same budget. No accommodation. No application fee stated.

A new funded artist-in-residence programme in the old KPN telephone exchange in The Hague, home to Flora Filmtheater and Café Restaurant Flora.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Fellowship: KB Fellowship at NIAS 2027-2028 (National Library of the Netherlands collections incl. born-digital; artists and researchers) (closes 15 Mar 2027)
item.description:
NIAS-KNAW (Netherlands Institute for Advanced Study) with the KB, National Library of the Netherlands
Deadline: 15 Mar 2027, 12:00 CET
Award: Personal stipend (figure not published); scholars at Dutch institutions get a Dutch University Grant paid to their institution instead. Office, subsidised Amsterdam housing where eligible (otherwise local transport reimbursement). No application fee.

One fellowship a year for work with the KB's collections, facilities and expertise, including its large digitised and born-digital holdings.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Open call: PhD Position in Space Law and Artificial Intelligence, EO-TRUST project (Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam) (closes 27 Nov)
item.description:
Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam, Faculty of Law
Deadline: 27 Nov 2026, 23:59 CET
Award: EUR 3,204 to 4,051 gross per month (at least 0.8 FTE). No application fee.

A funded law PhD on the legal and ethical governance of AI-enabled Earth observation under the EU AI Act, the proposed EU Space Act and space, security and military law, within the EO-TRUST project. Requires an LL.M.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Open call: Leiden Shorts 2027: International and National Competition Submissions (closes 11 Jan 2027)
item.description:
Leiden Shorts International Film Festival
Deadline: 11 Jan 2027
Award: Jury financial award (amount not stated) and an Audience Award. Fees EUR 15.50 regular / EUR 22 last chance (Brand New Eyes debut and student strand EUR 12.50 / 19).

Leiden Shorts takes short films up to 30 minutes completed after 1 January 2026, in all genres including animation, for its International and National Competitions and the Brand New Eyes strand for debuts and student films. Works in progress are accepted if finished before April 2027.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Open call: Cinedans FEST '28: Open Call for Screendance (Shorts, Docs, VR and Installations) (closes 30 Jun 2027)
item.description:
Cinedans
Deadline: 30 Jun 2027
Award: EXCEPTION: NOT FUNDED (festival call). Fees EUR 20 (International Short Film Competition) or EUR 15 (International Short Docs).

Cinedans, the Amsterdam dance-on-screen festival, takes screendance films up to 25 minutes for its competitions; other sections take VR, stereoscopic and installation work. Deadline 30 June 2027.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Futures of Listening x Immersive Audio Network: Residency Open Call (Bristol, IAN Festival 2027) (closes 21 Nov)
item.description:
Futures of Listening (FIBER, 4DSOUND, Robin Koek, Art of Sound) and the Immersive Audio Network (IAN)
Deadline: 21 Nov 2026, 23:59 CET
Award: EUR 1,750 residency fee (excl. VAT, paid on invoice), plus return travel from the Netherlands to Bristol and private accommodation for 22 to 30 January 2027. No application fee.

One residency for a freelance audio practitioner (composer, sound designer, audio maker, artist or researcher) registered in the Netherlands, to develop an existing project into a spatial, story-led sound work.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Fonds voor Cultuurparticipatie: Open Call Cultural Education and Digital Technology 2026 (closes 16 Dec)
item.description:
Fonds voor Cultuurparticipatie (with LKCA and DEN)
Deadline: 16 Dec 2026, 15:00 CET
Award: EUR 10,000 to EUR 25,000 per project, up to 100% of total project costs (no co-funding required). Total budget EUR 500,000.

Open call (Open Oproep Cultuureducatie en Digitale Technologie) for cultural education projects in which children and young people work creatively with digital technology. Run by the Fonds voor Cultuurparticipatie with LKCA and DEN.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Netherland-America Foundation: Cultural Grant Program (1 February 2027 Cut-Off) (closes 1 Feb 2027)
item.description:
The Netherland-America Foundation (NAF)
Deadline: 1 Feb 2027
Award: Typically up to USD 5,000 per project, depending on scope and impact; higher amounts possible depending on available budget. No application fee.

The Netherland-America Foundation funds professional artistic and cultural projects that show a clear exchange between Dutch and American artists, institutions or audiences, such as exhibitions, performances and other cultural initiatives that promote dialogue and collaboration.

Apply on the organiser's site
